data.description: Elegant Luxury in a Prestigious Community
data.long_description:
Canal Heights, nestled in the heart of Business Bay, offers a sophisticated lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most sought-after addresses. This modern development features meticulously designed studios and lavish 1-2 bedroom apartments, blending style with functionality. Each unit is crafted with premium finishes and state-of-the-art appliances to create an inviting, elegant living space.

Residents can indulge in a range of exclusive amenities, including a temperature-controlled swimming pool, fully equipped fitness center, BBQ and recreation areas, children’s playgrounds, and secure underground parking. With 24-hour security and dedicated concierge services, every detail has been curated to offer comfort and peace of mind. The location also provides easy access to Business Bay’s vibrant canal promenade, bustling offices, and popular dining spots.

Perfectly positioned, Canal Heights is just a 5-minute drive from Dubai Mall, 15 minutes from Jumeirah Beach and the iconic Burj Al Arab, and 25 minutes from the scenic Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah.

Flexible finance options available. For more information or to schedule a consultation, contact us at +97143233609.
